hint.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.crystal_f: Crystal Forest: the air here is charged — your mana returns a little faster.
hint.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.haunted_s: Haunted Swamp: spirits and shades roam the mist. It gets worse at night.
hint.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.twilight_: Twilight Grove: under the canopy it is always dusk. The violet crystals show the way.
hint.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.crystal_c: Magic Crystal Cavern: the crystals light everything and mana returns faster here.
hint.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.ember_cry: Embercrystal Wastes: glowing ember crystals grow on the Nether's floor and ceiling.
hint.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.astral_ga: Astral Gardens: End islands covered in amethyst and crystals that shine like stars.
command.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.not_fo: No %s within %s blocks (it only generates in NEW terrain).
journal.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.title: Enchanted Lands
journal.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.intro: There are places where mana leaked into the land and never left.
journal.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.lore: Forests with glass leaves, swamps where the dead do not rest, caverns that glow on their own. They are rare and only exist in lands not yet explored.
journal.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.crysta: Cool forests. Look for pale blue canopies and glowing rocks.
The leaves chime in the wind. They say each tree keeps a little of the world's first mana.
journal.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.haunte: A grey swamp with dark water and dead trees with blue lanterns.
Those who died here never left. The blue lanterns were not lit by the living.
journal.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.twilig: A dark forest with purple grass. It lies in the middle of Dark Forests.
The sun never finishes setting beneath this canopy.
journal.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.crysta: Beneath dry lands, deep down. You will see the glow before you arrive.
Mana seeped through the stone for ages and became crystal. The cavern breathes light.
journal.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.ember_: In the Nether. Blackstone ground and ember-colored crystals.
Even the Nether's fire crystallizes when there is too much mana.
journal.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.astral: Set foot in the Astral Gardens
On the outer End islands, far from the dragon's island.
Gardens no one planted, facing stars that do not exist.
